content: 7SABER is a brand developed by the London Institute of Identity (INSTID) and Tashkent agency GRANDPR, officially launched on June 25, 2021. They offer a product called Saber Sneakers, which are priced at $86. The sneakers are available in various colors including Cerulean, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. Size options range from 41 to 48. Here are some images of the Saber Sneakers: [Image 1](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/46436N39ObreDZPKk3AiR.jpg), [Image 2](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/464323MU6bL1enYSB7IGi.jpg), [Image 3](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/45947vtkXtKLKh6zxQX1e.jpg).
